# Functions to process tables for different omic types
format_rna <- function(df, useFDR=TRUE) {
  df <- df %>%
    select(1:3) %>%
    rename(Symbol = 1, log2FoldChange = 2, pvalue = 3) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
    mutate(Symbol = str_trim(Symbol)) %>%
    distinct(Symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    percentile_rank(Symbol, log2FoldChange)

  if (useFDR) {
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(padj = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "fdr")) %>%
      filter(padj <= 0.05)
  } else {
    df <- df %>%
      filter(pvalue <= 0.05)
  }

  df %>% top_hits(prec_cutoff = -0.1, omic_type = "RNA")
}


format_protein <- function(df, useFDR = TRUE) {
  df <- df %>%
    select(1:3) %>%
    rename(Symbol = 1, log2FoldChange = 2, pvalue = 3) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
    mutate(Symbol = str_trim(Symbol)) %>%
    distinct(Symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    percentile_rank(Symbol, log2FoldChange)

  if (useFDR) {
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(padj = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "fdr")) %>%
      filter(padj <= 0.05)
  } else {
    df <- df %>%
      filter(pvalue <= 0.05)
  }

  df %>% top_hits(prec_cutoff = -0.1, omic_type = "Protein")
}

format_phosphosite <- function(df) {
  #Takes phos Differential abundance data w a 'site_id' column as <genesymbol>_(STY)### 
  #The selected row supplies both logFC and adjusted P value to the score.
  select_phosphosite_rows(df, phosphosite_level = phosphosite_level) %>%
    transmute(
      Symbol = node,
      log2FoldChange = site_score
    ) %>%
    percentile_rank(Symbol, log2FoldChange) %>%
    top_hits(prec_cutoff = -0.1, omic_type = "Phosphosite")
}

format_kinase <- function(df) {
  names(df) <- stringr::str_trim(names(df))
  signed_effects <- extract_signed_kinase_effects(df)

  if (all(c("Method", "hgnc_symbol", "Rank") %in% names(df))) {
    kinase_scores <- df %>%
      dplyr::filter(Method == "KEA3") %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        Symbol = stringr::str_trim(as.character(hgnc_symbol)),
        `Z score` = as.numeric(Rank)
      )
    rank_desc <- TRUE
  } else if (all(c("Kinase", "effect_size", "n_peptides") %in% names(df))) {
    kinase_scores <- df %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        Symbol = stringr::str_trim(as.character(Kinase)),
        `Z score` = as.numeric(effect_size)
      )
    rank_desc <- FALSE
  } else {
    stop(
      "Kinase data must contain either Method/hgnc_symbol/Rank or ",
      "Kinase/effect_size/n_peptides columns."
    )
  }

  ranked_kinases <- kinase_scores %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Symbol), Symbol != "", is.finite(`Z score`)) %>%
    group_by(Symbol) %>%
    summarise(`Z score` = mean(`Z score`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    distinct(Symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    percentile_rank(`Symbol`, `Z score`, desc = rank_desc) %>%
    top_hits(prec_cutoff = -0.1, omic_type = "Kinase")

  ranked_kinases %>%
    dplyr::left_join(signed_effects, by = c("name" = "Symbol"))
}

format_krsa_peptides <- function(df) {
  mapping <- read_csv(here::here("data/assets/mapping_patch.csv")) %>% 
    rename(ID = Peptide) %>%
    bind_rows(stk_pamchip_87102_mapping, ptk_pamchip_86402_mapping)
  
  df %>%
    select(Peptide, totalMeanLFC) %>%
    distinct(Peptide, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    filter(abs(totalMeanLFC) >= log2(1.15)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(mapping, by = c("Peptide" = "ID")) %>%
    group_by(HGNC) %>%
    summarise(totalMeanLFC = mean(totalMeanLFC, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    distinct(HGNC, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    percentile_rank(`HGNC`, `totalMeanLFC`) %>%
    top_hits(prec_cutoff = -0.1, omic_type = "Peptide")
}

format_phosphosite_peptides <- function(df) {
  #Takes phos Differential abundance data w a 'site_id' column as <genesymbol>_(STY)### 
  #Doesnt use site, just genesymbol
  df %>%
    #tibble::rownames_to_column("site_id") %>%
    transmute(
      site_id = site_id,
      totalMeanLFC = logFC
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(site_id), !is.na(totalMeanLFC)) %>%
    distinct(site_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    
    filter(abs(totalMeanLFC) >= log2(1.15)) %>%
    
    mutate(
      HGNC = str_extract(site_id, "^[^_]+") #%>% 
             #toupper()
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(HGNC)) %>%
    
    #group_by(HGNC) %>%
    #summarise(totalMeanLFC = max(abs(totalMeanLFC)) * sign(mean(totalMeanLFC)))
    group_by(HGNC) %>%
    #This takes max instead of avg logfc for all sites (latter doesn't make sense for phos data since 
    # some sites are highly regulatory but others aren't)
    slice_max(order_by = abs(totalMeanLFC), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(HGNC, totalMeanLFC)
#   summarise(
#      totalMeanLFC = mean(totalMeanLFC, na.rm = TRUE),
#      .groups = "drop"
#    ) %>%
    distinct(HGNC, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    
    percentile_rank(HGNC, totalMeanLFC) %>%
    #they used this for other omic layers idk what it is
    top_hits(
      prec_cutoff = -0.1,
      omic_type = "Peptide"
    )
}


# Apply a process function to a dataframe based on its name
process_data <- function(df, name) {
  switch(
    name,
    "rna" = df %>% format_rna(),
    "protein" = df %>% format_protein(),
    "phosphosite" = df %>% format_phosphosite(),
    "kinase_stk" = df %>% format_kinase(),
    "kinase_ptk" = df %>% format_kinase(),
#    "peptide" = df %>% format_phosphosite_peptides(), # -Kunch
    "peptide" = df %>% format_krsa_peptides(),
    df
  )
}

fix_hgnc <- function(X) {
  if (!exists("HGNChelper_CurrentHumanMap")) {
    HGNChelper_CurrentHumanMap <<- quiet(HGNChelper::getCurrentHumanMap()) #Global voodoo
  }
  
  HGNChelper::checkGeneSymbols(X %>% pull(1), map = HGNChelper_CurrentHumanMap) %>%
    select(Symbol = 1, Suggested.Symbol) %>%
    mutate(
      Suggested.Symbol = if_else(
        Suggested.Symbol == "" |
          is.na(Suggested.Symbol),
        Symbol,
        Suggested.Symbol
      ),
      Suggested.Symbol = if_else(
        str_detect(Suggested.Symbol, ".+?(?= ///)"),
        str_extract(Suggested.Symbol, ".+?(?= ///)"),
        Suggested.Symbol
      )
    ) %>%
    inner_join(X %>% rename(Symbol = 1), by = "Symbol") %>%
    select(-Symbol, Symbol = Suggested.Symbol) %>%
    rename(name = 1)
}

fix_phosphosite_hgnc <- function(X) {
  if (nrow(X) == 0) return(X)

  site_parts <- X %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      .site_row = dplyr::row_number(),
      .parent = phosphosite_parent(name),
      .site_suffix = stringr::str_extract(name, "_[STY]\\d+$")
    )

  parent_map <- tibble::tibble(
    name = unique(site_parts$.parent),
    original_parent = unique(site_parts$.parent)
  ) %>%
    fix_hgnc() %>%
    dplyr::rename(.fixed_parent = name, .parent = original_parent)

  site_parts %>%
    dplyr::left_join(parent_map, by = ".parent") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(name = paste0(.fixed_parent, .site_suffix)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.site_row) %>%
    dplyr::select(-.site_row, -.parent, -.site_suffix, -.fixed_parent)
}

fix_phosphosite_measurements_hgnc <- function(X, phosphosite_level) {
  if (nrow(X) == 0) return(X)

  parent_map <- tibble::tibble(
    name = unique(X$protein),
    original_parent = unique(X$protein)
  ) %>%
    fix_hgnc() %>%
    dplyr::rename(fixed_parent = name, protein = original_parent)

  X %>%
    dplyr::mutate(site_suffix = stringr::str_extract(site_id, "_[STY]\\d+$")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(parent_map, by = "protein") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      protein = fixed_parent,
      site_id = paste0(fixed_parent, site_suffix),
      representative_site = site_id,
      node = if (isTRUE(phosphosite_level)) site_id else protein
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-site_suffix, -fixed_parent)
}

network_resource_cache_file <- function(resource, species, string_confidence = NULL,
                                        cache_dir = here::here("data/network_cache")) {
  parts <- c(resource, species)
  if (!is.null(string_confidence)) {
    parts <- c(parts, paste0("confidence_", gsub("\\.", "p", string_confidence)))
  }
  file.path(cache_dir, paste0(paste(parts, collapse = "_"), ".rds"))
}

load_or_build_network_resource <- function(cache_file, builder,
                                           cache_enabled = isTRUE(cache_network_resources)) {
  if (isTRUE(cache_enabled) && file.exists(cache_file)) {
    message("Reusing network resource cache: ", cache_file)
    return(readRDS(cache_file))
  }

  resource <- builder()

  if (isTRUE(cache_enabled)) {
    dir.create(dirname(cache_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    saveRDS(resource, cache_file)
    message("Created network resource cache: ", cache_file)
  }

  resource
}

generate_string_ppi <- function(species, confidence_threshold = 0.5) {
  species_id = c(human = "9606", mouse = "10090", rat = "10116")[species]

  cache_file <- network_resource_cache_file(
    resource = "STRING_v12_0",
    species = species,
    string_confidence = confidence_threshold
  )

  load_or_build_network_resource(cache_file, function() {
    links = str_glue("https://stringdb-downloads.org/download/protein.links.v12.0/{species_id}.protein.links.v12.0.txt.gz")
    info = str_glue("https://stringdb-downloads.org/download/protein.info.v12.0/{species_id}.protein.info.v12.0.txt.gz")

    names <- read_tsv(info) %>%
      select(1:2)

    read_delim(links, delim = " ") %>%
      mutate(combined_score = combined_score / 1000) %>%
      left_join(names, by = c("protein1" = "#string_protein_id")) %>%
      rename(protein1_symbol = preferred_name) %>%
      left_join(names, by = c("protein2" = "#string_protein_id")) %>%
      rename(protein2_symbol = preferred_name) %>%
      select(-protein1, -protein2) %>%
      filter(combined_score >= confidence_threshold) %>%
      mutate(cost = pmax(0.01, 1-combined_score)) %>%
      select(-combined_score) %>%
      rename(from = 1, to = 2)
  })
}
# Additional signaling-edge resources for the PCSF interactome.
# These functions return the same columns used by Kinograte: from, to, cost.

omnipath_species_id <- function(species) {
  ids <- c(human = 9606L, mouse = 10090L, rat = 10116L)

  if (!species %in% names(ids)) {
    stop("Unsupported species: ", species, ". Use human, mouse, or rat.")
  }

  unname(ids[[species]])
}

as_ppi_edges <- function(x, from_col, to_col, edge_cost, source_name) {
  missing_cols <- setdiff(c(from_col, to_col), names(x))

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      source_name, " data are missing expected column(s): ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
      ". Available columns: ", paste(names(x), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  x %>%
    transmute(
      from = as.character(.data[[from_col]]),
      to = as.character(.data[[to_col]]),
      cost = as.numeric(.env$edge_cost),
      source = .env$source_name
    )
}

as_phosphosite_edges <- function(x, edge_cost, source_name, observed_sites = NULL) {
  required_cols <- c(
    "enzyme_genesymbol", "substrate_genesymbol",
    "residue_type", "residue_offset", "modification"
  )
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(x))

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      source_name, " data are missing expected column(s): ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
      ". Available columns: ", paste(names(x), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  edges <- x %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      kinase = stringr::str_trim(as.character(enzyme_genesymbol)),
      parent_protein = stringr::str_trim(as.character(substrate_genesymbol)),
      residue = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(as.character(residue_type))),
      position = suppressWarnings(as.integer(residue_offset)),
      modification = stringr::str_to_lower(as.character(modification))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      modification == "phosphorylation",
      residue %in% c("S", "T", "Y"),
      !is.na(position), position > 0,
      !is.na(kinase), kinase != "",
      !is.na(parent_protein), parent_protein != ""
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      phosphosite = paste0(parent_protein, "_", residue, position),
      from = kinase,
      to = phosphosite,
      cost = as.numeric(.env$edge_cost),
      source = .env$source_name,
      edge_type = "kinase_to_phosphosite"
    )

  if (!is.null(observed_sites)) {
    edges <- edges %>%
      dplyr::filter(phosphosite %in% observed_sites)
  }

  edges %>%
    dplyr::select(from, to, cost, source, edge_type, kinase, phosphosite, parent_protein) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
}

collapse_undirected_ppi <- function(x) {
  if (!"edge_type" %in% names(x)) x$edge_type <- "protein_context"
  if (!"kinase" %in% names(x)) x$kinase <- NA_character_
  if (!"phosphosite" %in% names(x)) x$phosphosite <- NA_character_
  if (!"parent_protein" %in% names(x)) x$parent_protein <- NA_character_

  x %>%
    transmute(
      from_raw = stringr::str_trim(as.character(from)),
      to_raw = stringr::str_trim(as.character(to)),
      cost = as.numeric(cost),
      source = as.character(source),
      edge_type = as.character(edge_type),
      kinase = as.character(kinase),
      phosphosite = as.character(phosphosite),
      parent_protein = as.character(parent_protein)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(from_raw), from_raw != "",
      !is.na(to_raw), to_raw != "",
      from_raw != to_raw,
      is.finite(cost), cost > 0
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      from = if_else(from_raw <= to_raw, from_raw, to_raw),
      to = if_else(from_raw <= to_raw, to_raw, from_raw),
      cost = pmax(cost, 0.01),
      source = source,
      edge_type = edge_type,
      kinase = kinase,
      phosphosite = phosphosite,
      parent_protein = parent_protein
    ) %>%
    group_by(from, to) %>%
    summarise(
      cost = min(cost),
      source = paste(sort(unique(source)), collapse = "|"),
      edge_type = paste(sort(unique(edge_type)), collapse = "|"),
      kinase = paste(sort(unique(stats::na.omit(kinase))), collapse = "|"),
      phosphosite = paste(sort(unique(stats::na.omit(phosphosite))), collapse = "|"),
      parent_protein = paste(sort(unique(stats::na.omit(parent_protein))), collapse = "|"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      kinase = na_if(kinase, ""),
      phosphosite = na_if(phosphosite, ""),
      parent_protein = na_if(parent_protein, "")
    )
}

generate_omnipath_site_edges <- function(species, observed_sites, edge_cost = 0.5) {
  cache_file <- network_resource_cache_file("OmniPath_enzyme_PTM", species)
  raw <- load_or_build_network_resource(cache_file, function() {
    OmnipathR::enzyme_substrate(
      organism = omnipath_species_id(species),
      genesymbols = TRUE,
      license = "academic",
      cache = TRUE,
      silent = TRUE
    )
  })

  as_phosphosite_edges(
    raw,
    edge_cost = edge_cost,
    source_name = "OmniPath_enzyme_PTM",
    observed_sites = observed_sites
  )
}

generate_site_parent_edges <- function(observed_sites, edge_cost = 0.01) {
  tibble::tibble(
    from = observed_sites,
    to = phosphosite_parent(observed_sites),
    cost = as.numeric(edge_cost),
    source = "site_parent_identity",
    edge_type = "site_parent_identity",
    kinase = NA_character_,
    phosphosite = observed_sites,
    parent_protein = phosphosite_parent(observed_sites)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
}

generate_phuEGO_ppi <- function(species) {
  if (!exists("hgnc_set")) {
    hgnc_set <<- read_tsv("hgnc_complete_set.txt")
  }
  
  uniprot_to_hgnc <- hgnc_set %>%
    select(uniprot_ids, symbol) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    distinct(uniprot_ids, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data/assets/mmc4.xlsx"), skip = 1)
  
  interactions <- raw %>%
    select(Protein1 = NodeA, Protein2 = NodeB, `Combined score` = simGIC) %>%
    rename(from = Protein1, to = Protein2, cost = `Combined score`) %>%
    left_join(uniprot_to_hgnc, by = c("from" = "uniprot_ids")) %>%
    rename(from2 = symbol) %>%
    left_join(uniprot_to_hgnc, by = c("to" = "uniprot_ids")) %>%
    rename(to2 = symbol) %>%
    select(-from, -to) %>%
    rename(from = from2, to = to2) %>%
    relocate(cost, .after = to) %>%
    mutate(cost = as.numeric(cost)) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    mutate(cost = 0.5 + (cost - min(cost)) * (1 - 0.5) / (max(cost) - min(cost))) %>%
    mutate(cost = pmax(0.01, 1-cost)) %>%
    group_by(from, to) %>%
    summarise(cost = mean(cost)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  if(species != "human") {
    interactions <- interactions %>% 
      inner_join(babelgene::orthologs(.$from, species = params$species) %>% select(human_symbol, symbol), by = c("from" = "human_symbol")) %>%
      select(-from, from = symbol) %>%
      inner_join(babelgene::orthologs(.$to, species = params$species) %>% select(human_symbol, symbol), by = c("to" = "human_symbol")) %>%
      select(-to, to = symbol) %>%
      relocate(cost, .after = to)
  }
  
  interactions
}

data <- params$data %>%
  keep( ~ file.exists(here(.))) %>%
  map( ~ read_csv(., name_repair = "unique_quiet")) %>%
  imap(process_data)

#Fix HGNC symbols in all the data if input is human
if (params$species == "human") {
  data <- data %>%
    imap(~ if (.y == "phosphosite" && isTRUE(phosphosite_level)) {
      fix_phosphosite_hgnc(.x)
    } else {
      fix_hgnc(.x)
    })
} 

#Fix HGNC symbols for peptides, if we don't have human data but we do have peptide data, which will later get converted to species-specific orthologs
if (params$species != "human" & !is.null(data$peptide)) {
  data$peptide <- fix_hgnc(data$peptide)
}

#Combine kinase data from stk & ptk
data$kinase <- base::rbind(data$kinase_stk, data$kinase_ptk)

data <- data %>%
  discard_at(c("kinase_stk", "kinase_ptk"))

#Fix HGNC symbols for kinases, if we don't have human data but we do have kinase data, which will later get converted to species-specific orthologs
if (params$species != "human" & !is.null(data$kinase)) {
  data$kinase <- fix_hgnc(data$kinase)
}

#Get kinase ortholog symbols if non-kinase input is not human and kinase data was present, i.e., if we have kinase data and the RNA input is not human, we need to get the species-specific orthologs of the kinases.
if (params$species != "human" & !is.null(data$kinase)) {
  data$kinase <- data$kinase %>%
    inner_join(
      babelgene::orthologs(.$name, species = params$species),
      by = c("name" = "human_symbol")
    ) %>%
    select(name = symbol, prize, type, signed_effect)
}

#Get peptide ortholog symbols if non-kinase input is not human and peptide data was present, i.e., if we have kinase + peptide data and the RNA input is not human, we need to get the species-specific orthologs of the peptides now too.
if (params$species != "human" & !is.null(data$peptide)) {
  data$peptide <- data$peptide %>%
    inner_join(
      babelgene::orthologs(.$name, species = params$species),
      by = c("name" = "human_symbol")
    ) %>%
    select(name = symbol, prize, type)
}

get_chea3_enrichment <- function(genes, query_name = "myQuery", url = "https://maayanlab.cloud/chea3/api/enrich/") {
  # Prepare the payload
  payload <- list(query_name = query_name, gene_set = genes)
  
  # POST request to ChEA3 server
  response <- POST(url = url, body = payload, encode = "json")
  
  # Extract and parse the JSON response
  json <- content(response, "text")
  results <- fromJSON(json)
  
  results <- results %>%
    discard_at(c("Integrated--meanRank", "Integrated--topRank")) %>%
    bind_rows(.id="Method") %>%
    mutate(Rank = as.numeric(Rank),
           FDR = as.numeric(FDR)) %>%
    filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    group_by(TF) %>%
    summarise(Rank = mean(Rank, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Return the results as a list of dataframes
  return(results)
}

#Predict transcription factors involved in all the data so far
chea3_results <- get_chea3_enrichment(
  data %>% map(pull, name) %>% unlist() %>% phosphosite_parent()
) %>%
  percentile_rank(`TF`, `Rank`, desc = TRUE) %>%
  top_hits(prec_cutoff = .9, omic_type = "TF") #Currently, select the top 10%

# CHEA3 always returns human symbols, lets convert back.
if(params$species != "human") {
  chea3_results <- chea3_results %>%
    inner_join(
      babelgene::orthologs(.$name, species = params$species),
      by = c("name" = "human_symbol")
    ) %>%
    select(name = symbol, prize, type)
}

fisher_p_combine <- function(pvalues) {
  if (!is.numeric(pvalues)) {
    warning("Input is not a numeric vector. Returning NA.")
    return(NA)
  }
  
  pvalues <- pvalues[!is.na(pvalues)]
  if (length(pvalues) == 0) {
    warning("No valid p-values found after removing NA. Returning NA.")
    return(NA)
  }
  
  if (any(pvalues < 0 | pvalues > 1)) {
    warning("P-values must be between 0 and 1. Returning NA.")
    return(NA)
  }
  
  pvalues[pvalues == 0] <- .Machine$double.xmin
  
  chisq_stat <- -2 * sum(log(pvalues))
  
  df <- 2 * length(pvalues)
  
  combined_p <- pchisq(chisq_stat, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)
  
  return(combined_p)
}

#Here we make scores additive and concatenate the types with a | delimiter for plotting later.
combine_scores_patch <- function(df_rna = NULL, df_prot = NULL, df_phos = NULL, df_kin = NULL, tf_kin = NULL, df_pep = NULL) {
  
  base::rbind(df_rna, df_prot, df_phos, df_kin, tf_kin, df_pep) %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(name) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(inv_prize=1-prize) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(prize = fisher_p_combine(inv_prize),
                     type = paste(unique(type), collapse = "|")) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

}

phosphosite_input <- params$data$phosphosite

phosphosite_measurements <- if (!is.null(phosphosite_input) &&
    file.exists(here::here(phosphosite_input))) {
  readr::read_csv(here::here(phosphosite_input), name_repair = "unique_quiet") %>%
    select_phosphosite_rows(phosphosite_level = phosphosite_level) %>%
    { if (params$species == "human") {
        fix_phosphosite_measurements_hgnc(., phosphosite_level)
      } else . }
} else {
  tibble::tibble(
    node = character(), representative_site = character(), protein = character(),
    site_id = character(), logFC = numeric(), adj.P.Val = numeric(), site_score = numeric()
  )
}

kinase_effects <- summarize_signed_kinase_effects(data$kinase)
kinase_scores_for_combination <- if (!is.null(data$kinase)) {
  data$kinase %>% dplyr::select(name, prize, type)
} else NULL

observed_phosphoproteomic_nodes <- c(
  if (!is.null(data$phosphosite)) data$phosphosite$name else character()
) %>% unique()

network_phosphosite_measurements <- phosphosite_measurements %>%
  dplyr::filter(node %in% observed_phosphoproteomic_nodes)

combined_df <- combine_scores_patch(df_rna = data$rna,
                              df_prot = data$protein,
                              df_phos = data$phosphosite,
                              df_kin = kinase_scores_for_combination,
                              df_pep = data$peptide,
                              tf_kin = chea3_results)
dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(combined_df, "results/combined_node_scores.csv")

include_string_context <- if (!is.null(params$include_string_context)) {
  isTRUE(params$include_string_context)
} else TRUE

# A true protein modality requires the protein interactome. This leaves
# phosphosite-only behavior unchanged when protein input is absent.
has_protein_input <- !is.null(data$protein) && nrow(data$protein) > 0
include_protein_context <- include_string_context || has_protein_input
use_site_specific_network <- isTRUE(phosphosite_level) &&
  nrow(network_phosphosite_measurements) > 0

network_inputs <- build_phosphoproteomic_network(
  phosphosite_level = use_site_specific_network,
  species = params$species,
  selected_phosphosite_rows = network_phosphosite_measurements,
  kinase_effects = kinase_effects,
  include_string_context = include_protein_context,
  filter_sign = filter_sign,
  generate_omnipath_site_edges_fn = generate_omnipath_site_edges,
  generate_networkin_site_edges_fn = generate_networkin_site_edges,
  generate_phosphositeplus_site_edges_fn = generate_phosphositeplus_site_edges,
  generate_string_ppi_fn = generate_string_ppi,
  generate_phuego_ppi_fn = generate_phuEGO_ppi,
  generate_site_parent_edges_fn = generate_site_parent_edges
)

phosphoproteomic_network_mode <- network_inputs$mode
ppi_raw <- network_inputs$edges

if (nrow(ppi_raw) == 0) {
  stop("No interactome edges were available for the selected inputs and context settings.")
}

cat("\nPhosphoproteomic network mode:", phosphoproteomic_network_mode, "\n")

cat("\nRaw edge rows by source:\n")
print(
  ppi_raw %>%
    count(source, name = "edge_rows")
)

# Kinograte/PCSF uses an undirected interactome.
# Canonicalize A--B and B--A, remove invalid/self edges,
# and retain the lowest available cost for duplicate edges.
ppi_with_sources <- collapse_undirected_ppi(ppi_raw)

readr::write_csv(
  ppi_with_sources,
  "results/ppi_edges_with_sources.csv"
)

# Kinograte receives only its required three columns.
ppi <- ppi_with_sources %>%
  select(from, to, cost)

annotate_network_edges <- function(edges, edge_metadata = ppi_with_sources) {
  edges %>%
    mutate(
      .key_from = if_else(as.character(from) <= as.character(to), as.character(from), as.character(to)),
      .key_to = if_else(as.character(from) <= as.character(to), as.character(to), as.character(from))
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      edge_metadata %>%
        rename(.key_from = from, .key_to = to, ppi_cost = cost),
      by = c(".key_from", ".key_to")
    ) %>%
    select(-.key_from, -.key_to)
}

kinograte_res <- quiet(kinograte(combined_df, ppi_network = ppi, cluster = F, seed = 123, mu=1e-4,b=3))
#readr::write_csv(kinograte_res$nodes, "results/network_nodes.csv")
write_csv(

)
readr::write_csv(
  igraph::as_data_frame(kinograte_res$network, what = "edges") %>%
    annotate_network_edges(),
  "results/network_edges.csv"
)

score_plot <- function(df, title = "Prize Plot", subtitle = "", interactive = T) {
  
  df %>% 
    dplyr::mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 3) -> df
  
  if(interactive) {
    df %>% 
      echarts4r::e_charts(name) %>% 
      echarts4r::e_step(score, legend = F) %>% 
      echarts4r::e_visual_map(score) %>% 
      echarts4r::e_x_axis(axisLabel =  list(show  = F)) %>% 
      echarts4r::e_y_axis(name = "Normalized Prize", nameLocation = "center", nameGap = 40, nameTextStyle =  list()) %>% 
      echarts4r::e_tooltip(trigger = "axis") %>% 
      echarts4r::e_title(title, subtext = subtitle)
  }
}
score_plot(combined_df %>% rename(score = prize) %>% arrange(score), interactive = TRUE)

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

prot_fc <- if (!is.null(params$data$protein) && file.exists(params$data$protein)) {
  readr::read_csv(params$data$protein, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(name = .[[1]], Protein = .[[2]])
} else NULL

phos_fc <- if (nrow(phosphosite_measurements) > 0) {
  phosphosite_measurements %>%
    transmute(name = node, Phosphosite = site_score)
} else NULL

pep_fc <- if (!is.null(params$data$peptide) && file.exists(params$data$peptide)) {
  mapping <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/assets/mapping_patch.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    rename(ID = Peptide) %>% bind_rows(stk_pamchip_87102_mapping, ptk_pamchip_86402_mapping)
  readr::read_csv(params$data$peptide, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(Peptide, totalMeanLFC) %>% distinct(Peptide, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    left_join(mapping, by = c("Peptide" = "ID")) %>%
    group_by(HGNC) %>% summarise(Peptide = mean(totalMeanLFC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    transmute(name = HGNC, Peptide)
} else NULL

kin_score <- if (!is.null(data$kinase)) data$kinase %>% transmute(name, Kinase = prize) else NULL
tf_score  <- if (exists("chea3_results")) chea3_results %>% transmute(name, TF = prize) else NULL
rna_fc    <- if (!is.null(params$data$rna) && file.exists(params$data$rna)) readr::read_csv(params$data$rna, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(name = .[[1]], RNA = .[[2]]) else NULL

hm_df <- list(combined_df %>% transmute(name, Prize = prize), rna_fc, kin_score, pep_fc, prot_fc, phos_fc, tf_score) %>%
  purrr::compact() %>% purrr::reduce(full_join, by = "name") %>%
  group_by(name) %>% summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Prize)) %>% slice_head(n = 50) #top 50 genes

hm <- hm_df %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("name") %>% as.matrix()
hm <- t(scale(t(hm)))  # rowscale
hm[is.na(hm)] <- 0

fs_row <- max(6, min(11, 220 / nrow(hm)))
fs_col <- max(9, min(12, 70 / ncol(hm) + 6))

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  hm,
  name = "z-score",
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#3B4CC0", "white", "#B40426")),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = fs_row),
  column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = fs_col, fontface = "bold"),
  row_names_side = "left",
  border = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold")),
  column_title = "Integrated multi-omic evidence by network node"
)
